correctness.rationale: For p,q>=2 and proper nonempty deleted blocks, every root has squared norm 2; the projection lemma identifies the unique minimum enclosing sphere center as the least-norm convex combination. The exact block-marginal feasible domain is the triangle x>=0,y>=0,x+y<=1. Minimizing its strictly convex quadratic gives the Hall threshold theta=a/p+b/q=1, R^2=2-1/p-1/q-[uv/(u+v)](theta-1)_+^2, the positive unique block coordinates and the sharp contact classes and clearance 2h(theta-1). Independent SLSQP optimization checked 225 parameter quadruples including strict threshold cases; the quantified proof is the projection/KKT calculation, not these experiments.
